newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end steady ahead of elections.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end steady ahead of elections.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended a quiet day little changed on Tuesday as players awaited the outcome of the U.S. presidential and congressional elections.
Dealers said unconfirmed rumours of financial trouble at a small Japanese regional bank caused concern and the continued bullishness of bond markets also capped the market.
After hitting a high of 20,735, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract came off to finish at 20,640 against a previous 20,630. Market turnover was a thin 11,500 lots.

"The Democrats are never very friendly to business. If they get control of Congress, that could be a problem," said the trader, adding that President Bill Clinton was widely expected to be re-elected.
